changes: Full interval split/coalesce, transactional later-request-wins, leases, writer preference, physical registration IDs, generations, finalize and permanent tombstones retained; no second interval algorithm.
Header includes host pool_policy.h: mapping-page, physical-alignment and preferred-token constants alias the one typed policy source. NVNmappingRequest uses current tracked 40-byte typed host ABI.

Accept exact 0x1fe, 0x101 and 0x17b using the shared typed pool policy decoder, and preserve raw_kind 0xfe, 1 and 0x7b in every span. Legacy standalone classes 0 and 0x100 remain raw_kind 0. Kind participates in coalescing and contiguous leases; spans expose their exact kind, contiguous leases expose one kind. These are uncompressed color/D16/D32F labels, not native hardware compression codecs.

Additional strict register entry reuses the same register/reservation path but rejects and releases reservations outside the preferred host window before publication. The legacy entry keeps above-limit fallback. This is not a hardware VA-width claim.
Registration allocates its object before growing registry capacity, freeing it on grow failure so failed registrations retain existing capacity and allocations.

NVN_VPOOL_TESTING alone compiles allocator/reservation countdown failure controls, a real mmap high-address hint floor, and observable allocation/reservation/capacity accounting. No environment switch or test control symbols exist in production compilation.

Original complete t_vpool.c retains all 109 checks, 3000 randomized batches and 20000 remaps against 4 readers. Its relative include path is adapted; the one unsupported-class sample and label changes from now-supported 0x101 to unsupported compressed kind 0x107. t_vpool_port.c adds positive exact 0x101/0x17b kind and synthetic port coverage.
production_status: Included through the single graphics translation unit with a strict base-v0 adapter and canonical CPU/GPU resolver. The module owns no Metal resource or guest backing; the graphics owner separately enforces GPU format/kind/segment, submission pin, authority, and all-deallocator-ACK lifetime contracts.
